summary: We are looking for a motivated Python Developer Intern who is eager to learn backend development and automation. You will work alongside experienced developers to build features, write APIs, and improve existing applications using Python.
responsibilities: Write clean and efficient code using Python
Assist in developing backend logic and APIs using Django / Flask / FastAPI
Work with databases such as MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB
Debug issues and support testing activities
Collaborate with front-end and backend teams for feature integration
Follow coding standards and best practices
required_skills: Strong understanding of Python fundamentals and OOP concepts
Basic familiarity with any Python framework is preferred
Knowledge of SQL and REST API concepts
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
benefits: Practical experience on real development projects
Opportunity to convert into a Full-Time Python Developer role based on performance
